name: TRANSACTION CO.,Ltd.
summary: TRANSACTION CO.,Ltd. plans, designs, manufactures, and sells miscellaneous goods to companies and individuals in Japan and internationally. The company offers eco products that include reusable products made from organic cotton, recycled materials, biomass plastics, and natural materials, as well as upcycled finished goods; lifestyle products, including picture-style towels, acrylic products, suitcases, suitcase belts, and pet wear and related finished goods; and wellness products comprising sanitary products, such as masks.
